basis: Public Python Client over loopback UDP. Each installed count uses its own all-nine cold enrollment and readback, production OSC parser, scheduler and piecewise R(T) observer compiled natively. A separate (33 + 12 N)-node passive circuit and explicit thermal plant synthesize 12-bit ADC readings. Supply 5.8 V, 25 °C cold start, nominal paths, 18 µs setup and 8 µs blanking. Current peaks include both sampled model endpoints. Equivalent free-span temperature is distinct from axial maximum. No board or device exercised.

interface_examples.basis: Separate nominal 25 °C cold starts, four wires, 5.8 V, 450 °C; real loopback sockets and compiled scheduler.
